candidates.name: long-direct-king-state
candidates.hypothesis: Generation-1 K2 was under-optimized; a longer float stage and three times as many QAT epochs improve the existing full architecture-3 table without changing runtime.
candidates.rowWeighting: one equal weight per train row

candidates.name: shared-plus-supported-king-delta
candidates.hypothesis: Target-blind pooling improves rare and unseen king-conditioned rows while retaining bucket-specific capacity where the fresh train split supplies enough occurrences.

conditionedOccupancyParameterization.initialSharedValue: For each p, S[p] is the canonical float value of I0 conditioned row (bucket 10, p).
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.initialDeltaValue: For each (b,p), D[b,p] is the canonical float I0 value at (b,p) minus S[p].
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.occurrenceDefinition: Count each active (bucket,base-piece-feature) occurrence once across both perspectives of every split-0 row; do not read a target field.
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.deltaAtOrAboveThreshold: train with its own Adam moments
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.deltaBelowThreshold: remain fixed at its initialized value for all 48 epochs and do not update Adam moments
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.sharedGradient: sum the gradients of every active bucket instance for the same base piece feature into S[p]
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.qatForward: materialize every S[p]+D[b,p], quantize the ordinary architecture-3 table, and apply the straight-through gradient to S and eligible D
conditionedOccupancyParameterization.export: materialize the ordinary 48,376-row architecture-3 feature table; no latent S or D tensor is present in the deployed file

candidates.rowWeighting: one equal weight per train row

candidates.name: shared-king-delta-phase-group-aligned-soft-wdl
candidates.hypothesis: The G3B capacity control plus a train objective aligned with the phase-macro group-balanced gate and a modest teacher soft-WDL term improves search-relevant calibration.

rowWeighting.G_p: number of distinct global groupIds represented in frozen phase p in split 0
rowWeighting.n_pg: number of split-0 rows in frozen (phase p, global groupId g)
rowWeighting.crossPhaseGroupRule: one global groupId remains one split unit, but its point-estimate row weights are computed separately in every phase cell in which it occurs
rowWeighting.batchNormalization: divide the weighted batch sum by the sum of weights in that batch
rowWeighting.epochInvariant: visit every split-0 row exactly once per epoch

objective.loss: weighted binary cross-entropy with the teacher probability as the soft target, evaluated with a numerically stable logit formula

validationSelection.candidateCheckpointMetric: phase-macro group-balanced quantized residual Huber loss

targetAndLoss.prediction: quantized residual correction in side-to-move centipawns

aggregation.rowToPhaseGroup: arithmetic mean of row losses for each frozen (phase,global groupId) cell
aggregation.phaseGroupToPhase: arithmetic mean of group-cell means in the frozen phase
aggregation.phaseToMetric: equal arithmetic mean of opening, middlegame, late, and endgame

validationSelection.winner: eligible candidate with the lowest common validation metric
validationSelection.tieRationale: Prefer target-blind capacity control, then the same capacity control with the additional objective, then the unrestricted table.
validationSelection.ifNoneEligible: fail generation without decoding held-out targets or creating match suites
validationSelection.fatalCandidateFailure: mark only that candidate ineligible and continue the other preregistered candidates without changing any recipe

bootstrap.sampling: Within every observed phase-incidence stratum, sample its global groupIds with replacement; assign one multiplicity to each sampled global groupId and reuse that multiplicity in every phase cell belonging to the group.

requiredPrelabelImplementationVerificati.implementationFailureAction: abort before labels; do not weaken or reinterpret this preregistration

risks.risk: A lower residual Huber loss may not improve move choice or Elo.
risks.mitigation: Require independent paired equal-node and equal-time promotion; match results may reject but never select a different recipe.

risks.risk: G3B/G3C can underfit genuinely bucket-specific tactics in rare king regions.
risks.mitigation: Retain unrestricted G3A, preserve I0 rare deltas, and select on a common validation metric.

risks.risk: G3C soft-WDL targets are a transformation of the same teacher CP, not independent game outcomes.
risks.mitigation: Use weight 0.25, keep Huber weight 1.0, and never select on the composite training loss.

risks.risk: Even the doubled corpus can leave rare king, en-passant, clock, Champion, Wizard, or detached-corner rows weakly observed.
risks.mitigation: Apply feature-only prelabel coverage gates, migration fallback, and frequency-gated deltas.

risks.risk: Residual runtime evaluates HCE plus a full-refresh 12.39 MB NNUE, so equal-time strength can fail despite equal-node gains.
risks.mitigation: Keep runtime dimensions fixed and require equal-time telemetry; treat accumulator or SIMD work as a separate preregistered runtime experiment.

risks.risk: Reusing a safe generation-2 selected export could be interpreted as indirect reuse of failed-generation labels.
risks.mitigation: Resolve the public-status-only initializer rule before generation-3 labels, use a fresh orbit-disjoint corpus and suites, and fall back to generation-2 K0 unless every priority-1 condition is satisfied.

risks.risk: The S-plus-D optimizer and weighted soft-WDL objective add implementation and provenance risk.
risks.mitigation: Require deterministic finite-difference, materialization, replay, canonical export, and whole-corpus C++ parity self-tests before the pre-label seal.
